import subprocess

# Final comprehensive verification
print("=" * 60)
print("FINAL VERIFICATION")
print("=" * 60)

# 1. Check git log
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "log", "--oneline", "base..HEAD"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
commits = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')
print(f"\nCommits on top of base: {len(commits)}")
for c in commits:
    print(f"  {c}")

# 2. Verify each commit changes only semver.py
all_ok = True
for commit in [c.split()[0] for c in commits]:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "-r", "--name-only", commit],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    files = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')
    if files != ['semver.py']:
        print(f"ERROR: {commit} changed unexpected files: {files}")
        all_ok = False

if all_ok:
    print("\nAll commits change only semver.py: OK")

# 3. Verify working tree is clean
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "status", "--short"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
if result.stdout.strip():
    print(f"WARNING: Working tree has uncommitted changes:\n{result.stdout}")
else:
    print("Working tree is clean: OK")

# 4. Verify m1 public name: __getitem__
result = subprocess.run(
    ["grep", "-c", "def __getitem__", "semver.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(f"\nm1 - __getitem__ defined: {'OK' if int(result.stdout.strip()) > 0 else 'MISSING'}")

# 5. Verify m2 public name: comparator types include list and str
result = subprocess.run(
    ["grep", "comparable_types.*list.*str", "semver.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(f"m2 - comparator allows list/str: {'OK' if result.stdout else 'MISSING'}")

# 6. Verify m3 public names: deprecation warnings
m3_funcs = ['parse', 'format_version', 'bump_major', 'bump_minor', 'bump_patch',
            'bump_prerelease', 'bump_build', 'finalize_version', 'replace']
missing = []
for func in m3_funcs:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["grep", f"{func} is deprecated", "semver.py"],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    if not result.stdout:
        missing.append(func)

if missing:
    print(f"m3 - Missing deprecations: {missing}")
else:
    print(f"m3 - All {len(m3_funcs)} deprecation warnings present: OK")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("TASK COMPLETE - All milestones implemented")
print("=" * 60)
